summary: Replaced the process-wide settings with an immutable Settings value, settings.make() and an explicit conf parameter on every function that needs a setting. Import-time reads, stale caches and default-argument settings are removed, and the tests are moved to the new API. The unit tests pass (73). About 600 randomized CLI runs matched the original package byte for byte except for Python tracebacks, and 200 library calls in one process matched the original CLI.
